events.name: HackWithAditya 2026
events.what: Submit a working prototype (Level 1) as a team of 4–6 college students; shortlisted teams build at the finale.
events.desc: Online hackathon open to currently-enrolled Indian college/university students. Prototype screening, then a 3-day build.

events.name: KIIT 4th Hackathon 2027 (ICDCIT)
events.what: Submit a project proposal on rural-India challenges; shortlisted teams build on campus.
events.desc: National hackathon alongside the ICDCIT conference at KIIT. Proposal screening then finals.

events.name: Hoya Hacks 2027 — Georgetown
events.what: Apply and build at Georgetown's collegiate hackathon (listed on Devpost).
events.desc: College-focused US university hackathon, open to student hackers worldwide.

deadlines.txt: Applications via Devpost — check the event page

events.name: James Dyson Award 2027
events.what: Submit an engineering/design invention that solves a problem (students + grads within 4 years).
events.desc: The premier student design-engineering prize — free, global, with national + international cash awards. 2026 closed 15 Jul; 2027 opens ~March.

events.name: Junction 2027 — Europe's largest hackathon
events.what: Apply as a team to Europe's largest hackathon; travel grants for some teams.
events.desc: ~2,000 hackers, broad tracks (AI, web, hardware). Open internationally; registration usually ~September.

events.name: Huawei ICT Competition 2026-27
events.what: University students compete in ICT tracks (network, cloud, computing, AI) across national → regional → global rounds.
events.desc: A huge global student ICT contest. Dates & registration vary by country/region; national rounds Nov–Dec 2026, regional ~Mar 2027.

events.name: Kaggle — ML & Data-Science Competitions
events.what: Enter ML/data-science competitions; the Getting Started track is beginner-friendly for students.
events.desc: The largest data-science competition platform — featured comps with cash + learning comps. Free to enter.

events.name: Zindi — Data-Science Challenges & University Hackathons
events.what: Enter real-world data-science/ML challenges, including student & inter-university events.
events.desc: Data-science competitions on real problems with cash/points; student-friendly difficulty labels. Good AI/ML practice.

events.name: MHacks 2027 — University of Michigan
events.what: Apply to Michigan's flagship hackathon (over $40K in prizes).
events.desc: A major US collegiate hackathon, open to students worldwide; applications ~Aug–Sep.

events.name: HackIllinois 2027 — UIUC
events.what: Apply to the open-source-focused hackathon at UIUC.
events.desc: A unique open-source hackathon; open to students, applications ~Dec–Jan.

events.name: Myntra WeForShe HackerRamp 2027
events.what: Women-in-tech hackathon for engineering students; pre-placement-interview chances with Myntra.
events.desc: National women-only engineering-student hackathon (prizes ~₹5 lakh, PPIs). Next cycle expected ~mid-2027.

events.name: Qualcomm Snapdragon / Edge-AI Developer Hackathons
events.what: Build real-world on-device / edge-AI solutions using Snapdragon across the hackathon series.
events.desc: Snapdragon Multiverse / Edge-AI Developer Hackathons — city editions across India; edge AI, multi-device. Strong EE/embedded + AI.

deadlines.txt: City editions announced through the year

events.name: Vishwakarma Awards — Hardware Innovation Challenge
events.what: Build a HARDWARE innovation to a theme over ~6 months; finale bootcamp at an IIT.
events.desc: National hardware innovation challenge for STEM students (3,600+ last cycle). Mechanical/electrical/robotics friendly. Current 2026-27 cycle runs to Feb 2027; next ~Aug 2027.
